rows.note: Use 塞車 as the all-purpose everyday expression for a traffic jam or heavy traffic.

example.english: There was such a traffic jam on the road at rush hour today that we could barely move.
example.traditional: 今日放工時間太多人出車，條路塞車塞到郁唔到。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 fong3 gung1 si4 gaan3 taai3 do1 jan4 ceot1 ce1 tiu4 lou6 sak1 ce1 sak1 dou3 juk1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use 車龍 when you want to emphasize the long line of vehicles formed by the jam.

example.english: Before the tunnel, there was already a traffic jam of cars stretching as far as I could see.
example.traditional: 入隧道前已經排咗成條車龍，望唔到盡頭。
example.jyutping: jap6 seoi6 dou6 cin4 ji5 ging1 paai4 zo2 seng4 tiu4 ce1 lung4 mong6 m4 dou2 zeon6 tau4
